entries.title: A longer press on a card's picture or choice works on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone or iPad, holding a finger on a card a moment before lifting it could do nothing: a picture opened no viewer and a choice stayed unpicked, more often while the card was busy. A press now does what a tap does, once, however long you hold it. Holding a card's picture opens it rather than picking it up to drag, and holding a finger on a card's words outside a choice still selects them.
entries.noPicture: The viewer and the choices look as they did; only a held press now reaches them, which one picture cannot show.
